packageRules.description: brace-expansion must stay on 1.x. It is an OVERRIDE, so its version is forced on every consumer regardless of what they declare — and its only consumer, minimatch@3 (via serve-handler), declares ^1.1.7 and calls the module as a function. v2+ export { EXPANSION_MAX, expand } instead of a callable, so brace patterns throw 'expand is not a function' at runtime. 1.1.16 already carries the DoS fix, so there is nothing to gain from a major here.
